statusDefinitions.covered: The signed corpus answers the common questions inside the subsystem scope; this does not imply exhaustive internal or troubleshooting knowledge.
statusDefinitions.partial: The signed corpus supports part of the subsystem scope and the remaining gaps are named explicitly.
statusDefinitions.gap: The subsystem is important to product expertise but has no signed claim that supports an answer yet.

subsystems.title: Onboarding and mental model
subsystems.scope: The app's basic conversation, workspace, Home, first-turn, and output-location concepts.

subsystems.title: Conversations and workspaces
subsystems.scope: Creating, restoring, organizing, filtering, searching, printing, moving, deleting, model inheritance, generated images, launcher behavior, and undoing conversations and workspaces.

subsystems.title: Composer and turn control
subsystems.scope: Writing, attaching inputs, sending, steering, queuing, interrupting, and redirecting an interactive turn.

subsystems.title: Inspector, artifacts, agents, and skills
subsystems.scope: The workspace and conversation inspector tabs, including files, changes, artifacts, delegated agents, and skills.
knownGaps: There is no signed end-to-end troubleshooting guidance for artifact rendering, agent activity, or skill discovery failures.

subsystems.title: Extensions and plugins
subsystems.scope: MCP servers, Claude plugins, Codex plugins, marketplaces, installation surfaces, and extension trust.
knownGaps: The corpus does not cover extension authentication failures, marketplace refresh failures, or provider-specific compatibility diagnosis.

subsystems.title: Approvals and interactive trust
subsystems.scope: Permission, write-containment, plan, question, extension, provider-access, and wait-mode interactions.
knownGaps: There is no complete signed matrix for permission modes, remembered approvals, macOS TCC state, and provider-specific approval behavior.

subsystems.title: Scheduled and ambient work
subsystems.scope: Task triggers, unattended permission modes, background execution, results, and menu-bar controls.
knownGaps: The corpus lacks task-by-task authoring walkthroughs and structured diagnosis for triggers, background helpers, delivery, and missed runs.

subsystems.title: Mac automation and app integration
subsystems.scope: AppleScript, JXA, Shortcuts, App Intents discovery, saved capabilities, computer use, Services, and mechanician links.
knownGaps: The reviewed automation set is narrow, and no native guide yet teaches an automated Mac-app workflow or detailed TCC troubleshooting.

subsystems.title: Accounts, providers, and enterprise configuration
subsystems.scope: Claude and Codex authentication, model lanes, Keychain ownership, and signed Vertex or Bedrock enterprise provider configuration.
knownGaps: Provider recovery, model availability, Vertex and Bedrock operation, enterprise policy applicability, and managed-profile troubleshooting are not covered in depth.

subsystems.title: Keyboard and text scaling
subsystems.scope: The documented conversation, window, utility, work-state, search, printing, Quick Look, and text-size shortcuts.

subsystems.title: Mechanician Help system
subsystems.scope: Signed product authority, Ask Mechanician, the Help inspector, search, manual and agent-directed native guides, demonstrations, and the closed expert boundary.
knownGaps: There is no typed known-issue catalogue, Help-consumable cross-subsystem diagnostic snapshot, or independently updated and rollback-safe online corpus.

subsystems.title: Runtime, routing, and security architecture
subsystems.scope: The app/daemon boundary, exact provider-lane ownership, tool profiles, persistence ownership, and retrieved-data trust.
knownGaps: The signed corpus is an architectural map, not a complete protocol, session-recovery, subagent, or event-attribution reference.

subsystems.title: Storage, persistence, and recovery
subsystems.scope: Authoritative and derived databases, storage-root admission, uncertainty, and safe recovery boundaries.
knownGaps: Schema evolution, backup and restore, import and export, corruption triage, and legacy recovery are not complete user-facing procedures.

subsystems.title: Source extension points
subsystems.scope: Finding subsystem owners and adding tools, provider lanes, and native surfaces.
knownGaps: The corpus does not provide complete subsystem checklists, API contracts, schema recipes, or runnable extension examples.

subsystems.title: Diagnostics and known issues
subsystems.scope: Reproduction context, owning-boundary identification, bounded evidence, falsification, and fix verification.
knownGaps: No typed, version-applicable known-issue records or opt-in redacted live diagnostic snapshot ship in the authority.

subsystems.title: History and origin
subsystems.scope: Selected historical architecture and storage lessons that must not be mistaken for current specifications.
knownGaps: The corpus preserves selected lessons but not a complete origin, product chronology, release history, or decision record index.

subsystems.title: Release, updates, and packaging
subsystems.scope: Development packaging plus Daily and Stable channels, versioning, signing, notarization, Sparkle feeds and deltas, publication, rollback, and provenance.
knownGaps: The corpus names development verification and dogfood packaging, but not release-channel operation, update diagnosis, signing, notarization, publication, provenance, or rollback.

subsystems.title: Accessibility and localization
subsystems.scope: VoiceOver, keyboard focus, reduced motion, contrast, text scaling beyond shortcuts, localization, and assistive input behavior.
knownGaps: No signed Help claim currently supports a complete accessibility or localization answer.
